## Task CLOUD-RELAY-4.3: Gateway registration + rendezvous endpoints — summary

The registration + rendezvous surface is complete and **validated end-to-end** (36/36 tests pass, including HTTP integration against real PostgreSQL via Testcontainers).

### Endpoints (`Endpoints/GatewayEndpoints.cs`, `Endpoints/RendezvousEndpoints.cs`)
- `POST /gateways` — requests a registration token; creates the identity PENDING (201, one-time plaintext token; only its `sha256:` fingerprint is persisted — SP-07)
- `POST /gateways/{gatewayId}/register` — presents the token; moves the identity to REGISTERED
- `POST /gateways/{gatewayId}/rotate` — rotates a REGISTERED gateway's token; the old token stops working immediately
- `GET /rendezvous/gateways` — lists registered gateways as rendezvous targets (SP-02 filters PENDING/SUSPENDED/REVOKED)
- `GET /rendezvous/gateways/{gatewayId}` — one gateway's rendezvous info (404 when unregistered)
- `GET /rendezvous/lookup?participant=...` — resolves a typed participant address to its serving gateway (`system:<gatewayId>` and participant-directory forms)

### Behaviour
- `Services/GatewayService.cs` — full registration lifecycle; `EnsureStatus` rejects non-REGISTERED identities with the SP-02 error codes; `VerifyTokenOrThrow` is constant-time and never leaks token bytes into logs/errors
- `Security/RegistrationTokens.cs` — `hgrt_` + 256-bit base64url tokens, `sha256:` fingerprints, constant-time verification
- `Api/RegistrationModels.cs` — request validation mirroring gateway.schema.json shapes; `ProtocolError`-shaped 400s
- `Api/ApiErrors.cs` — maps `GatewayServiceException` to stable reserved error codes

### Root cause fixed during validation
`RelayApiFactory` originally used `ConfigureAppConfiguration` to override `ConnectionStrings:Relay`, but the factory host runs in the Development environment where `appsettings.Development.json` defines the dev database string — which shadowed the in-memory override, so the test Relay silently connected to the developer's local `humangateway_relay` database instead of the fixture container. Fixed with `builder.UseSetting("ConnectionStrings:Relay", ...)` (host settings have the highest precedence). With the fix, all 36 tests pass against a throwaway Testcontainers PostgreSQL.

### Verification
- `dotnet test tests/HumanGateway.Relay.Tests` — 36/36 pass (unit: token shape/entropy/fingerprint/verification, request validation, record→protocol mapping; HTTP integration: handshake, wrong-token/unknown/duplicate rejections, rotation invalidation, route/body mismatch, rendezvous list/get/lookup, SP-02 404s)
- `dotnet build HumanGateway.slnx` — 0 warnings, 0 errors
